climate_pressure: Projected longer dry periods and reduced rainfall.
documented_impact: Reduced agricultural and public water availability in the Zeta and Bjelopavlici plains and coastal areas.
fcv_mediator: Competing agricultural, public-supply and tourism water uses place pressure on a shared resource.
possible_consequence: The 2025 plan warns of possible water-use disputes, particularly involving tourism; it does not report violence.
alternative_explanations: Seasonal tourism demand, infrastructure and allocation decisions also affect scarcity and competition.
uncertainty: Conditional planning risk with unspecified emissions pathway and no dispute counts, actors or violent outcome; not a conflict forecast. Not independently reverified in the 27 October 2026 remediation; check the cited passage before relying on this claim.
resilience_factors: The national plan provides a coordination framework; delivery and local allocation effectiveness were not assessed.
compact_statement: The 2025 plan links projected dryness and shared water demand to possible water-use disputes, not observed violence.
